subject: [hw] DONE IP rev 5: 763 checks; exit-70 guest stop + gate + idle; P03 client E2E; P04 objects; F15 fixed
body:
DONE IP rev 5. Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/daemon/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IP PASS 763/763
    249/249 ASan+UBSan, 249/249 -O2, 249/249 TSan; 16/16 real n2vhost.
  bash gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh -> IOS BUILD OK
    vcodecd 391536 B, n2vcd_cli 70000 B, rwjpeg_tool 68432 B, all linked
    P04 objects: annexb 10280, n2hwenc_vt 22552, n2hwenc_client 3544, n2hwenc_register 2688
    IV archive rebuilt from current sources, extracted and linked directly; V32/V33 shim tables present by nm, no fake hardware.
  bash gpu/hwcodec/install/stage.sh dev --host-test -> STAGE HOST TEST OK

Lead/R2 items:
- Guest stop is fatal per the lead: reply E_GUEST to the owner, seq-0 E_GUEST to every other client that has sent traffic, one fatal log line (reason carries the address), raw bounded VENC/VENC_C1 power off, _exit(70). Tested for a request-time stop and a watchdog stop; plist RunAtLoad true, --gate, KeepAlive {SuccessfulExit:false}, ThrottleInterval 10.
- F15 closed: build_ios always rebuilds IVs archive, extracts runtime members (fake excluded), checks _n2shim_thread/_n2shim_stdio present; IP-REAL uses --whole-archive and t_real asserts the N2VHOST tables thread/stdio are non-zero and unresolved=0.
- F16 power through g.vhw; F17 --session-idle-ms (default 10s, tested); F18 LRU registry >16; F19 registered-buffer sizes and early in==out rejection; F20 bounds; F21 build_ios -Werror.
- P03 client is integrated end-to-end: run_tests builds n2vcd_cli and encodes two NV12 frames through a second vcodecd (HELLO/OPEN/ENC_FRAME/CLOSE, Annex B checked).
- opus-ios asks: --gate (exit 0 + log), milestone-advance logging, O_NONBLOCK console, vendor bin/lib installer fix - all implemented.
- P04 objects compiled and handed to gpu/video; registration-gate snippet posted to hw-lead.

Open: RWVC_DMA_INFO rev2 is in the header and both user-space wrappers; K02/IK still need the kernel ioctl (first phone blocker). No phone run. R2 re-run requested. Full detail: gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/IP/STATUS.md.
